title: 2026 UK ETS market, CCM and auction QA controls

sources.publisher: UK ETS Authority and Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Taking part in the UK Emissions Trading Scheme markets

sources.title: Cost Containment Mechanism trigger prices and average monthly prices

facts.source_fact: UK ETS market guidance and CCM figures were updated on 10 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach update date to market-policy records.

facts.source_fact: The market guidance reflects a revised 2026 auction calendar published by ICE on 1 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use the revised calendar rather than earlier 2026 schedules.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 auction-calendar revision accounts for maritime emissions entering the UK ETS from July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach maritime inclusion timing when interpreting supply schedules.

facts.source_fact: The Auction Reserve Price was increased from £22 to £28 in 2026 to reflect inflation.
facts.expected_handling: Version ARP values by effective date.

facts.source_fact: From 2027 the Auction Reserve Price is intended to adjust annually with inflation under the published policy.
facts.expected_handling: Treat future ARP values as policy-driven and year-specific.

facts.source_fact: The Cost Containment Mechanism is a price-based intervention mechanism for the UK ETS market.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat CCM trigger price as an emissions limit.

facts.source_fact: CCM trigger prices are calculated from the applicable preceding two-year reference period.
facts.expected_handling: Store reference-period dates with trigger prices.

facts.source_fact: From 2023 onward the CCM requires six consecutive months with monthly average prices above the applicable trigger price.
facts.expected_handling: Require all six monitoring-month conditions before trigger status.

facts.source_fact: Monthly average carbon price is calculated from end-of-day settlement prices for the relevant December futures contract.
facts.expected_handling: Carry futures-contract and averaging-method provenance.

facts.source_fact: From 1 December 2025 to 30 November 2026 the 2026 December futures contract is used for the published monthly-average calculation.
facts.expected_handling: Use the correct futures-contract vintage.

facts.source_fact: The July 2026 CCM trigger price is £133.85 for the 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2025 reference period.
facts.expected_handling: Bind the value to July 2026 and its reference period.

facts.source_fact: The published table records the CCM as not triggered for July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer intervention for July 2026.

facts.source_fact: The August 2026 CCM trigger price is £137.71.
facts.expected_handling: Bind the value to August 2026.

facts.source_fact: The September 2026 CCM trigger price is £139.57.
facts.expected_handling: Bind the value to September 2026.

facts.source_fact: The October 2026 CCM trigger price is £139.82.
facts.expected_handling: Bind the value to October 2026.

facts.source_fact: The November 2026 CCM trigger price is £141.21.
facts.expected_handling: Bind the value to November 2026.

facts.source_fact: The December 2026 CCM trigger price is £142.68.
facts.expected_handling: Bind the value to December 2026.

facts.source_fact: The January 2027 CCM trigger price is £143.90.
facts.expected_handling: Mark this as a future trigger-price record until January 2027.

facts.source_fact: The Authority states the CCM cannot trigger before January 2027 because at least one prior monitoring month was below the applicable trigger condition.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the published no-trigger conclusion rather than recalculating loosely.

facts.source_fact: The guidance states the next monthly CCM update is scheduled for 10 August 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Treat current CCM data as versioned and subject to monthly update.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve market-policy values and published status exactly.
Attach auction, secondary-market, CCM and allowance-supply boundary.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents treating price mechanisms as emissions measurements.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach month, reference period, calendar version and update date.
Carry futures-contract, averaging and Authority-source provenance.
Do not convert UK ETS market prices into parcel-level measured emissions.
